title: Day One: contextual Android editor
role_for_mira: Android editor and contextual-tool reference for Journal.

provenance.platform: Android; official guide images dated July 2026
provenance.kind: documented editor states; selection is a separate branch

target_reference.units: logical design units, not measured donor dp

spatial_ergonomic.measurement_basis: Qualitative visual reading of retained frames. Regions below are relative roles; source screenshots/GIFs do not expose device density or reliable native dp. Marketing/device chrome is not counted as app content.

regions.description: Top: confirmation/undo/menu; center: writing; lower area: contextual tools above the visible keyboard.
Writing remains visible while a formatting bar is open.
A bottom sheet presents heading choices over the document.

spatial_ergonomic.reference_zone_status: Proposed comparison grid only; donor controls may fall outside these bands. Not a fixed-coordinate implementation rule.

visual_density.value: Writing: variable with content; toolbar: compact; heading sheet: low.

states_and_triggers.limitation: Visible states are observations; documented arrows use source flow/guide descriptions. No event-handler names, gesture thresholds, or unseen screens are inferred as measured behavior.

observation.value: Still guide images show branches, not a continuous recording. Keyboard animation, picker timing, and gesture physics cannot be recovered from them.

visual_or_documented_feedback.value: Keyboard and text-selection affordances are visible. No app haptic cadence or sound behavior is established.

hierarchy.value: The document dominates. Tools use icons and context rather than permanent paragraphs of instruction. Some tools need disclosure; this does not prove that extra taps are always helpful.

copy_and_cognitive_load.note: No OCR word-count or grade-level measurement is claimed. Use the Mira copy sheet for exact comparison text.

mira_synthesis_candidate.value: Keep writing/caret and Save entry reachable with the keyboard. Preserve the existing prompt, appearance, audio-note, and session actions; no new rich-text feature set is implied. Separate entry saving, AI follow-up, and session finalization.
